method.collection: GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest requests and BeautifulSoup; current yyrw HTML and fixed Terminus GitHub commit
method.normalization: NFKC + removed whitespace + quote substitutions + split at Chinese full-stop/question/exclamation sentence marks
method.note: A computational comparison of current derivative content, not a character-for-character authentication of the original Renwu article.

summary.semantic_assessment: Two small local differences; no evidence from this comparison of wholesale changes to the narrated interview.

difference_inventory.inference: Formatting/caption handling in the surviving texts; not evidence that a factual claim was excised.
An agency name was expanded in the reposted copy. This does not establish editorial motive or an external directive.

extra_page_level_differences: yyrw uses an expanded headline; Terminus uses the shorter title.
yyrw opens its displayed article text with '我爱我的祖国。', unlike the body start in the fixed Terminus copy.
Author/photographer/editor attributions are presented differently in the two hosting templates.
Both copies display March 10, 2020 as a date, but only Terminus has the independently located repository commit timestamps discussed in AF08.
limitations: Does not establish the original Renwu WeChat first-edition bytes or publication time.
Does not establish that the yyrw version was online during the March 2020 removal period.
Does not establish why the title, site wrapper, or abbreviation differs.
Normalized-text equivalence is not raw-byte equivalence; attached raw hashes identify the exact retrieval representations.
The report is for research only; quoted article content must not be republished in full.
